entries.quote: Anlage III – Verkehrs- und verschreibungsfähige Betäubungsmittel: Morphin
entries.note: Annex III: tradable and prescribable narcotic (prescribed under the BtMVV). Secondary source; verify against BtMG Annex III.

entries.quote: Anlage III – Verkehrs- und verschreibungsfähige Betäubungsmittel: Codein (3-Methylmorphin), mit Ausnahmen
entries.note: Annex III, with exceptions: preparations without another Annex I-III substance containing up to 2.5% or up to 100 mg codeine (base) per divided dose are excepted (stricter prescribing rules still apply to people dependent on narcotics or alcohol). Secondary source; verify against BtMG Annex III.

entries.quote: Anlage III – Verkehrs- und verschreibungsfähige Betäubungsmittel: Diazepam, mit Ausnahmen
entries.note: Annex III, with exceptions: preparations without another Annex I-III substance up to 1% as syrup or drops (max 250 mg per pack) or up to 10 mg diazepam per divided dose are excepted. Secondary source; verify against BtMG Annex III.

entries.quote: Anlage III – Verkehrs- und verschreibungsfähige Betäubungsmittel: Alprazolam, mit Ausnahmen
entries.note: Annex III, with exceptions: preparations without another Annex I-III substance up to 1 mg alprazolam per divided dose are excepted. Secondary source; verify against BtMG Annex III.
